newsitem.title: USA: US Airways to furlough 42 more pilots.
newsitem.headline: US Airways to furlough 42 more pilots.

text.p: US Airways Group Inc plans to furlough 42 pilots this fall, as it continues to implement downsizing plans announced earlier this year, a company spokesman said.
The 42 pilot positions slated for fulough are in addition to 103 pilot job cuts that were previously announced, said US Airways spokesman Rick Weintraub.
In May, US Airways said it would cut unprofitable routes, consolidate facilities and reduce its fleet.
US Airways is currently in labor negotiations with its unionized employees. Until a cost-cutting agreement is reached, US Airways has said it must focus on becoming a smaller, regional carrier.
The new furlough announcement "is part of management's harsh negotiating strategy," said Jim Gardner, a spokesman for the pilots union said.

The Air Line Pilots Association representatives said they will picket on Tuesday to express their support for the US Airways's pilots who are scheduled to lose their jobs on July 1 as part of the first round of layoffs.

The pilots union, which represents about 5,000 employees at the carrier, said it recognizes US Airways' competitive challenges, but said management's downsizing plan "fails to position this airline for the future."
